title: Onboarding, messaging and closing panels by keyboard only
spec: Rule 1 of the Craft accessibility standard, tested with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Esc and typed text only. Join from an invitation link, set up the authenticator, sign in, open a room and send a message: Tab reaches each field and button in reading order, Enter on a focused button does what a click does, and Enter in a form's one-line field submits it when it is ready and otherwise keeps focus in that field. A new screen starts with nothing focused (no text field is focused for the person, so a phone shows no keyboard on its own), and the authenticator entry is named. In Calendar, Esc closes the innermost thing open: a lobby confirmation or the lobby, the meeting form, the Cancel confirmation, then the area. A confirmation opens with focus on its safe answer. When a form, confirmation, lobby or the Calendar closes, by Esc or by its own button, focus returns to the control that opened it.
